categories.label: Medium
categories.note: The physical surface it was made on

items.t: Two colour risograph. Slight misregistration, overprint where the inks cross, coarse grain, paper tooth showing through.
Hand pulled screenprint. Flat spot inks, uneven coverage, off registration, visible paper white.
Coarse halftone on cheap newsprint, slight dot gain, limited ink.
Marker and felt tip. Streaky fills, pooling at the edges, visible overlap where the pen doubled back.
Ink over graphite. Pencil construction lines left showing, nothing erased.
Bold flat cutout shapes. Limited saturated palette, clear silhouettes, one flat shadow tone, no gradients.
Loose marker doodle on white. Single weight line, spot colour accents, deliberately imperfect.
Indie comic ink. Uneven expressive line, flat spot colour, hatching only in shadow.
Cut paper collage. Torn edges, mixed paper textures, slight shadow where pieces overlap.
Matte gouache flats. Visible brush marks, dry edges, no gloss anywhere.
Mid century print cartoon. Textured overprint, warm muted flats, simplified shapes.
Ballpoint on cheap paper. Scribbled shadow, biro shine, scanned slightly crooked.
